title: Activate skill manifest (activate.yaml)
description: Governance metadata that sits beside every SKILL.md in a Meridian marketplace plugin. Written by Activate (Builder/Promoter) and read back by Activate; humans edit only through the Activate editor or a reviewed PR.

id.description: Skill slug. Must equal the skill directory name and the SKILL.md frontmatter `name`.

owner.description: Owner identity: the person's work email or Claude user_id. Resolved to an Activate Person on sync.

team.description: Activate team slug (maps to the Claude RBAC group). `shared` for cross-team plugins.

family.description: Workflow family used for library facets (e.g. meeting-prep, client-communications).

rung_required.description: Minimum ladder rung a learner must hold to be assigned this skill.

sample_cases.description: Relative directory holding cases.json (should / should-not / ambiguous cases).

baseline_task.description: Name of the Baseline records this skill is measured against.

grade_ref.description: Grader run / Grade id that passed this version.

approved_by.description: Approver identities; compliance approvals are prefixed `compliance:`.

successor.description: Slug of the skill that replaces this one. Required when status is deprecated.
